findings.message: IDisposable local 's' is used after it is disposed

event 'bus.E' is subscribed (handler 'OnE') to 'Bus' — a DI singleton (application-lifetime) service that outlives 'Vm'; the strong subscription promotes 'Vm' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a captive/region escape (leak, no release path)

effect re-runs on every render: dependency 'opts' is an object literal created in render scope, so its identity changes on every render; the effect performs IO, which can become a request storm — stabilise 'opts' with useMemo/useCallback (or move it out of render)
